# Prime Basket

> Prime Basket is a premium grocery storefront for fresh produce, dairy, pantry essentials, beverages, snacks, home care, and fast mobile-first shopping.

Base URL: https://prime-basket-pb.vercel.app/

Primary entry points:
- https://prime-basket-pb.vercel.app/

Site summary:
- Consumer-facing grocery storefront.
- Supports catalog browsing, product detail views, cart, checkout, wishlist, account flows, and chatbot-assisted shopping.
- Region-aware storefront experience for India and Kenya.
- Languages currently surfaced in the UI include English and Swahili.

Key content areas:
- Home catalog discovery
- Category browsing
- Product detail and related products
- Cart and payment flow
- Account, orders, refunds, addresses, and support areas

Operational notes for LLMs:
- Product catalog visibility can vary by configured region.
- Some content is client-rendered in the browser.
- Live catalog data may depend on deployment environment variables.
- Use the public home URL as the canonical reference for the storefront.

Contact:
- support@primebasket.com
